mapper.select: SELECT 'event' AS kind, slug, ST_Y(location::geometry) AS latitude, ST_X(location::geometry) AS longitude, title, starts_at, ends_at, venue_name FROM event WHERE status = 'public' AND >= #{now} AND ST_Intersects(location::geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(#{west}, #{south}, #{east}, #{north}, 4326)) ORDER BY starts_at, id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT 'notice' AS kind, slug, ST_Y(location::geometry) AS latitude, ST_X(location::geometry) AS longitude, title, type, is_official, starts_at, ends_at FROM notice WHERE status = 'public' AND (ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at >= #{now}) AND location IS NOT NULL AND ST_Intersects(location::geometry, ST_MakeEnvelope(#{west}, #{south}, #{east}, #{north}, 4326)) ORDER BY starts_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
